lessonTitle: Land Boom and Bust in the 1920s
title: Boom and Bust Beach
details: 📅 Q3 · Unit 10 · Modern Florida Takes Shape

badge.name: Field Seal 24
badge.line: Only field historians earn this one. You went where your teacher can't go, and you brought back proof.

hook.look: A field file is a job card. It tells a historian where to go and what to bring back.
hook.head: Field File 24 · Boom and Bust Beach
rows: Your teacher, still stuck inside Canvas
hook.alt: A huge billboard standing on an empty beach
hook.cap: A billboard selling building lots on the beach near Miami, 1922. State Archives of Florida.
hook.note: In the 1920s people bought Florida land just to sell it again. Then it all crashed. Can you build that story on a beach?

opti.brief: She can't leave Canvas, so you build it. Show the boom and the bust on one beach. Then send her one photo.
opti.desk: No headset? Use my desk. Play the game, then write 2 sentences for your teacher.

vr.h3: Build the Boom and the Bust
vr.look: A boom is when prices go up fast. A bust is when they crash. Build each one on its own side of the beach.

steps.title: Get ready
steps.html:
These are the models you will use. In VR, type the gray word in the Models search box to find each one.

@MODELS@

In VR, this page is on the Canvas tab.

steps.title: Go in
steps.html:
🔗 First time only: connect Canvas at xr.optimaed.com. See Having trouble in VR? below.

Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type Deserted in Filter environments. Click Deserted Isles, then Begin Solo.

steps.title: Build the boom and the bust
steps.html: Boom side: the 2 houses, the truck and the 2 coins. Bust side: the 2 piles of lumber and the crate.

steps.title: Take your photo and send it
steps.html:
Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Fit your whole build in the tablet. Click Take photo.

On the Canvas tab, pick @CANVAS@. Click Choose from My Files, pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag.

🔁 To fix it, send a new photo.

steps.title: Check and leave
steps.html: Press the Meta button, then click Quit. Check that your photo is in the Canvas assignment. Not there? See Having trouble in VR?

extra.html: Leave empty sand in the middle. After 1926, many lots sat empty for years.

vr.full: One photo that shows the boom side and the bust side.

studio.title: Boom to Bust, in Order
studio.look: Six things that happened in Florida in the 1920s. They are mixed up.
studio.do: Tap the step that happened first, then the next one.

labels.step: Tap the step that comes next.

game.miss: Not yet. What had to happen first?
game.done: In order! Prices were based on hype, so the boom could not last.

steps.name: Cars and new roads bring families south
steps.ok: Yes! The Dixie Highway led to Miami.
steps.hint: First, people had to get to Florida.

steps.name: Developers cut land into lots and sell them with ads
steps.ok: Yes! Billboards promised sunshine and easy money.
steps.hint: Families are coming. What did land companies do?

steps.name: Buyers sell their binders again for more money
steps.hint: Lots are for sale. What did many buyers do next?

steps.name: A magazine warns that prices are too high (1925)
steps.hint: Prices kept going up. Who noticed?

steps.name: Prices stop going up and start to fall (1926)
steps.hint: The warning came true. What happened to prices?

steps.name: A hurricane hits Miami (September 1926)
steps.ok: Yes. The storm ended the boom.
steps.hint: The last thing was a storm.

studio.full: Your game is done, and your 2 sentences have 20 words or more.
